headline: MSCI Warns Indonesia of Potential Market Index Downgrade to Standalone Status
summary: MSCI warned it could remove Indonesian equities from its emerging markets index in 2027 and reclassify the country as a standalone market, prompting discussions with President Prabowo.
why: MSCI market index classifications govern billions of dollars in passive foreign portfolio investment flows into international stock exchanges.

impacts.name: Jakarta Composite Index
impacts.why: Threatened downgrade by MSCI risks triggering substantial capital outflows from global fund managers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Warning of index reclassification created selling pressure on Indonesian equities over outflow concerns.
